project_name: Ev Lezzetleri - Günlük Ev Yemeği ve Meze Sipariş Sistemi

visual_enhancers.texture: Warm organic tones with subtle terracotta and olive accents, evoking homemade warmth.

components.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header with logo, nav links (Günlük Menü, Mezeler, Hamur İşleri, Tatlılar, Teslimat Bölgeleri, Hakkımda), phone quick-call, and WhatsApp order CTA button.
components.hero_section: Emotional warm intro featuring authentic homemade food imagery, daily menu highlight, and instant WhatsApp order trigger.
components.daily_menu_grid: Categorized interactive menu cards (Meze, Hamur İşi, Tatlı) with quantity selector, ingredients list, price, and 'WhatsApp ile Sipariş Ver' instant checkout button.
components.neighborhood_delivery_checker: Interactive postal code / neighborhood checker for delivery zones (Kadıköy, Moda, Fenerbahçe, Göztepe, Suadiye, etc.) and pickup option.
components.about_chef_section: Personal story of the home cook, cleanliness guarantee, daily fresh preparation notes with high quality cozy kitchen imagery.
components.reviews_section: Customer testimonials with ratings praising the authentic taste like mom's cooking.
components.footer: Rich footer with working hours, contact info, Instagram link, quick links, and WhatsApp direct link.

image_urls.description: Traditional Turkish dining spread with tea and savory pastries.
Turkish meze dishes including börek and potato salad.
Woman in an apron stands in a rustic kitchen.

universal_guidelines: Ensure all interactive buttons have data-testid attributes.
WhatsApp buttons must pre-fill the cart items and total sum.
Never use pure black or pure white; use warm off-white #FDFBF7 and rich charcoal #2C221E.
All cards must have clear hover states and smooth transition effects.
Responsive mobile-first layout with clean padding and generous spacing.
